| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/effects.ts` | NEW — `EffectsSystem` with 16-slot ring pool + 16-slot trace pool. Pre-allocated meshes, cloned materials per slot for independent opacity, no per-frame allocation. Exposed `world.globals.effects = { playMuzzleFlash, playBulletTrace }`. |

Added `tickRecoil(delta)` that runs every frame for every weapon (held or not), exponentially decays kick-back + pitch-up to zero. Smaller marker geometry: `SphereGeometry(0.0117, 8, 8)`. Calls `effects.playMuzzleFlash` + `playBulletTrace` per shot; trace endpoint = hit world point or muzzle + dir × 30m for misses. |
